**Bloomerang CRM starts at $125 per month (billed annually, or $1,500 per year), with pricing scaled by the number of contacts tracked in the database; additional products like Bloomerang Fundraising ($40/month annually) and Bloomerang Volunteer ($119/month annually) are available separately or bundled.** [1][2]

### Core Pricing Details
- **Bloomerang CRM**: Begins at **$125/month** (annual billing required); includes donor management, engagement scoring, email marketing, unlimited users, and support. Higher tiers add features like unlimited automated outreach and event tools.[2]
- **Bloomerang Fundraising**: Starts at **$40/month** (annual); covers donation forms, events, text fundraising, and mobile apps. Add-ons like auctions increase costs.[2]
- **Bloomerang Volunteer**: Starts at **$119/month** (annual); includes volunteer scheduling, communication, and data sync with CRM.[1][2]
- **The Giving Platform** (full bundle): **$524/month** (contact sales for details); integrates all three products with expert support.[2]

All plans feature unlimited users, free support, and annual billing. No free version or trial exists, and costs rise with record volume—user reviews note a perceived base around **$300/year** for small nonprofits, seen as affordable but with potential add-ons like training.[1]

### User Perceptions and Comparisons
Reviewers praise value for small organizations, though some report upselling during demos.[1] Compared to alternatives:
| Product          | Starting Price | Notes                  |
|------------------|----------------|------------------------|
| **Bloomerang CRM** | $125/month    | Unlimited users[1][2] |
| **Neon CRM**     | $99/month     | Lower entry[1]        |
| **Double the Donation** | $999 (likely annual) | Higher for matching gifts[1] |

Note: Search results on "Bloomerang lilac" plants (e.g., $30–$180) are unrelated to the nonprofit CRM software.[3][4] Pricing as of available 2026 data may vary; contact Bloomerang for custom quotes.[2]
